description: For replicating a look: finds cuts and gradual transitions (dissolves, fades and dips through black or white, wipes) and the shots between them, measures each shot's palette over its own frames (OKLab, weighted by screen time), reads how much the picture changes on every frame, and lists the moves with their duration in frames and easing family. Writes motion-spec.json (machine-readable, with word and cut anchors), STYLE.md, TIMELINE.md and ANALYSIS.md to the workspace. Then look at the moves with `frames` every_frame, and complete the typography, systems and 'why it works' sections in those files; re-running `style` only refreshes their measured blocks.

end.description: Range end (default the end, at most 180 s at a time).

source.description: The video: a link (YouTube and other sites), a path to a local file, or `inbox` for the newest file in the inbox folder.
